request.summary: Build a verified operational dashboard for a support workflow.
request.user_outcome: Support leads can see current workload, aging items, and blocked cases without manual spreadsheet work.
non_goals: Do not replace the source ticketing system in this release.

success_metrics.name: Freshness
success_metrics.target: Dashboard data is no more than 15 minutes old.
success_metrics.check: Run the freshness query and read the generated report.

constraints.description: No customer PII appears in screenshots, logs, or demo fixtures.

interfaces.name: Dashboard
interfaces.contract: Shows workload, aging, and blocked case views with verified empty, loading, and error states.

gates.expected_evidence: Build contract report is PASS or NOT_APPLICABLE for a non-runtime snapshot.
Gate registry report confirms all required class and risk gates are declared.
Pre-build estimate is valid and reconciles with STATE.budgets.
Harness state report is PASS once runtime state exists.
Phase order and prior-stage evidence are valid before advancement.
Referenced evidence exists and supports the verdict it is used for.
Accepted risks and high-risk ship decisions have approved owner signoff with evidence.
debate/OPEN.json is empty at ship, and any ADR records have rejected alternatives, dissent, ownership, and a typed index.
Prompt refinement rewrites the raw request into an enterprise build brief with outcome, acceptance criteria, routing, specialist plan, verification plan, and stop conditions.
Delivery orchestration proves the selected agent roster, SDLC gates, role independence, frontend/backend coverage, handoffs, worktree boundaries, and audit trail.
Project context proves AGENTS/CLAUDE/rules context, context budget, baton, source refs, and subagent handoff artifact/validation refs.
Self-improvement report mines traces, scouts current GitHub repos or source patterns, validates bounded proposals, and captures reusable lessons with result evidence.
Independent evaluator report scores the artifact against the requested outcome with rubric evidence, confidence, bias checks, and no blockers.
QA report proves unit/integration, functional, logic, integration, data integrity, security, and UX/resilience checks with fresh evidence.
Declared required skills have machine-readable breadcrumbs or no skill floor applies.
Documented shell blocks parse cleanly.
Plan and specification lint pass.
Requirements trace to implementation tasks.
Product intent has a non-stub PRD or is explicitly not applicable.
User-facing product work has a dated best-in-class benchmark or is explicitly not applicable.
Product/company completeness is explicit across value loop, app surface, business model, trust, ops, and launch.
Every production layer is owned, evidenced, or consciously deferred with risk ownership.
UI work has a design contract or no UI surface applies.
Error handling and async failure checks pass.
Code-producing work has a reproducible developer environment or no code stack applies.
Configuration access is validated and committed env secrets are absent.
Non-functional requirements are quantified when NFR discipline is present.
Observability anti-patterns are absent or no source files apply.
Performance context has tail-latency budgets and no detected regression.
Security report passes or records an explicit skip.
Dependency advisory report passes or records an explicit skip.
Declared API surfaces have machine-readable contracts.
Schema and migration checks pass or do not apply.
Confidentiality review is recorded where sensitive output exists.
Eight-dimension scoreboard meets target, per-dimension floors, security floor, locked targets, evidence refs, and freshness.
Terminal audit certificate has scores, 13-layer walk, intended-vs-implemented evidence, no blockers, no shortfalls, and fresh reproduced evidence.
Release, handoff, and recovery evidence are present where applicable.
README quickstart is present and runnable, or the project has no README yet.
Declared required tools are installed.
Fresh test output plus a browser screenshot or accessibility snapshot.

manual_checks: Review the final handoff against the requested support workflow outcome.

unknowns.question: Which ticket fields are contractually safe to display?
